crime_description: Poaching a critically endangered white rhino from a wildlife reserve. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside park ranger, financial motives, remote burner phone coordination, offshore accounts, and private flight plans.

suspect.name: Diana Walsh
suspect.fake_alibi: Diana claims she was on a legitimate photographic safari in a different part of the reserve.

secrets.value: A corrupt park ranger who provided Diana with the rhino's exact GPS location.
Diana was hired by a wealthy syndicate to obtain the rhino horn for traditional medicine.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
